title: Number of Sets of K Non-Overlapping Line Segments
summary: Determine the number of ways to draw exactly k non-overlapping line segments on a 1-D plane with n points at x = i, where each segment covers two or more points and endpoints have integral coordinates.
statement: Determine the number of ways to draw exactly k non-overlapping line segments on a 1-D plane with n points at x = i, where each segment covers two or more points and endpoints have integral coordinates. The result is given modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: Segments use distinct endpoints per segment, may share endpoints with neighboring segments, and may not overlap in their interiors. Return the count modulo 1,000,000,007.
hints: Sharing endpoints can be transformed into choosing 2k ordered boundaries from n+k-1 positions.
Compute the binomial coefficient and reduce it modulo the required prime.
Shifting each later shared boundary separates equal adjacent endpoints, giving a bijection with strictly chosen transformed boundaries.
